official_curriculum.source_document: Uploaded PDF: لأحة السويس.pdf (44 pages), internal bylaw for the integrated Medicine and Surgery programme, Faculty of Medicine, Suez University.

modules.name: Primary & secondary care (pediatrics, family medicine and community)
Primary & secondary care (Obstetrics/Gynaecology, family medicine and occupational)
Medicine I (endemic hepatology and GIT, infectious diseases, endocrinology, nephrology, clinical pathology, cardiology, radiology, chest, oncology)
Surgery I (general surgery, cardiothoracic, urology, neurosurgery)

longitudinal_components.name: Research project I and II
longitudinal_components.delivery: 2 hours/week for 30 weeks, taught within each educational block

longitudinal_components.name: Field training I and II
longitudinal_components.delivery: 4 hours/week for 30 weeks, taught within each educational block

longitudinal_components.name: Professional and communication skills I and II
longitudinal_components.delivery: 2 hours/week for 30 weeks, taught within each educational block

longitudinal_components.name: Research project III and IV
longitudinal_components.delivery: 2 hours/week for 30 weeks, taught within each educational block

electives.assessment: Pass/fail by portfolio and objective examination; completion required before progression.

assessment.formative: Weekly formative feedback in study sessions, skills laboratory and field work; not included in marks.

phase_1_end_of_semester_assessment.written_question_mix: MCQ and problem-solving/MEQ; the bylaw's diagram/text gives the proportions.

final_phase_2_exam.written_component: Clinical problem-solving (MEQ) and competency assessment including research critique and management skills.

assessment.progression: Phase progression requires successful completion of required educational units/groups; see bylaw attendance and progression rules.

credit_and_workload.note: The bylaw contains totals and table entries that should be preserved as printed rather than recalculated from inconsistent OCR/table totals.

limitations: The bylaw provides module titles, codes and broad groupings, but not detailed course-specification learning outcomes for every module.
No internship duration, rotation sequence or internship competency sign-off schedule is specified in this uploaded document.
Several departments listed in the faculty's department catalogue are not shown as separately coded modules in the course table; do not infer a standalone block for them.
This document's current applicability to the user's cohort has not been independently confirmed.
